# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**10:1** What is a mortal compared to all this? And what can a being made of clay do that counts as a great wonder?

**10:2** For such a being lives steeped in wrongdoing from the moment of birth, and drowns in guilty faithlessness until the day they die.

**10:3** I know that no human being can claim to own righteousness, and no mortal walks a flawless path.

**10:4** Every righteous act belongs to God Most High alone; and no one's path holds steady.

**10:5** Unless the spirit God crafted for them shapes their way into something whole.

**10:6** So that everything God has made may recognize the force of God's power and the depth of God's mercy on all whom God has chosen.

**10:7** As for me — shaking and terror seized me, and every bone in my body felt crushed.

**10:8** And my heart melted like wax beside a flame, and my knees buckled like water pouring down a hillside.

**10:9** For I remembered all my failures alongside the unfaithfulness of my ancestors.

**10:10** When the wicked rose up against Your covenant and the corrupt rose against Your word.

**10:11** This is a being that lives in wrongdoing from the womb, and in treacherous guilt right through to old age.

**10:12** For I said to myself, my rebellion has cost me my place in Your covenant.

**10:13** But then I called to mind the power of Your hand and the sheer immensity of Your mercy.

**10:14** And I stood back up, and my spirit found the strength to face the suffering head-on.

**10:15** For I planted myself firmly in Your covenant-faithfulness and in Your overflowing compassion.

**10:16** For You wipe away wrongdoing, purifying people of guilt through Your own righteousness.

**10:17** You do not do this for humanity's sake, but for the sake of Your own glory.

**10:18** For it is You — You who made both the righteous and the wicked.

**10:19** And when Your judgment arrives, who will be left standing?

**10:20** And what is anyone born of a woman to be counted as righteous?

**10:21** I know that no mortal can claim righteousness, and no human being walks a perfect path.

**10:22** Every righteous deed belongs to God Most High alone, and no person's path holds firm.

**10:23** Unless the spirit God made for them holds them up.

**10:24** And You shaped all the work of the earth and the pattern of every task since before time began.

**10:25** And You created nations for their service and armies of spirits for Your realms to govern.

**10:26** You gave them their assignments for all the ages and the sentences for their appointed eras.

**10:27** For You set their laws in place before time began, and the work of every [...] You spread out in front of You.

**10:28** The paths every person walks in everything they do [...] You laid out before Your eyes.

**10:29** And it is recognized in Your wise knowledge that You charted their course before eternity.

**10:30** And nothing happens without You. And nothing is known unless You will it.

**10:31** Every righteous act belongs to God Most High alone; and no person's path holds steady unless the spirit God fashioned for them secures it.

**10:32** And You shaped the breath that powers the tongue, and You know every word it will say.

**10:33** And You ordained what the lips would produce before they ever existed.

**10:34** And You measured out words on a line, and rationed the breath of every spoken syllable.

**10:35** And You release sounds according to their hidden purposes, and the flowing of breath according to their count.

**10:36** To put Your glory on display and to tell the story of Your wonders through all Your faithful acts.

**10:37** And the verdicts of Your justice; and to celebrate Your name through every mouth that knows You, and they will bless You without end.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 10 is a fitting culmination. Three times the speaker returns to the same confession: all righteousness belongs to God; human paths fail without divine spirit (10:4, 10:22, 10:31). The speech passage (10:32-36) is staggering: God pre-measured every word, every breath, every syllable. Predestination here is not cold doctrine but warm doxology.*
